1.w: A song of ascents. I look up toward you, the one enthroned in heaven.

2.w: Look, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female servant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes will look to the Lord , our God, until he shows us favor.

3.w: Show us favor, O Lord , show us favor! For we have had our fill of humiliation, and then some.

4.w: We have had our fill of the taunts of the self-assured, of the contempt of the proud.
